mockup_description.layout: Full-page mobile dashboard, opens on login/tab-select. Header: date + 'Vos cours et registres de la journée'.
key_elements: KPI strip: '6 Cours aujourd'hui', '2 Registres soumis', 'En cours: 3e A Mathématiques 10:00-11:00'
Ordered list of today's course slots, each showing time range, class, subject, room, student count
Per-slot status badge: 'En cours' (highlighted, blue border) / 'Soumis' (green) / 'Manquant' (red) / 'À venir' (grey)
'Saisir maintenant' primary CTA on the in-progress slot
Reminder banner: 'N'oubliez pas: tous les registres doivent être soumis avant 18:00 aujourd'hui'
Bottom tab bar: Accueil / Présence / Emploi du temps / Classes / Plus
interactions: Tap a slot -> opens intake for that slot
'Manquant' slots visually distinct (red) to prompt action
Tap 'Saisir maintenant' -> jumps straight into the in-progress class's roster

what_matches: The underlying data to build this exists: real classScheduleSlots (Section 20) + real attendance rows could answer 'submitted/missing/in-progress' per slot
what_differs: Current page opens directly into a class/subject/period PICKER (dropdowns), not a today's-agenda list
No per-slot submitted/missing/in-progress status is shown to the teacher at all -- that view only exists for school_admin on the audit dashboard, not for the teacher taking attendance

No bottom tab bar / mobile-app-shell navigation pattern anywhere in this Next.js web app (it's a responsive web dashboard, not a native/PWA shell) -- this mockup assumes an app-like frame this project doesn't have

missing_to_add.item: New teacher-facing 'my schedule today' view: GET already-real classScheduleSlots filtered by teacherId + today's dayOfWeek, left-joined against today's attendance to compute per-slot status (submitted / missing / in-progress by comparing current time to slot start/end)
missing_to_add.notes: Real data to build this already exists (Section 20 scheduling + Section 1 attendance). This is a genuinely buildable, non-fabricated feature -- just wasn't in scope for ATTENDANCE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md.

missing_to_add.item: Wire this as the landing view of /dashboard/attendance for role=teacher, keep the class/period picker as a manual override underneath
Deadline reminder banner ('submit before 18:00') -- would need a configurable cutoff time, currently no such setting exists anywhere in schoolSettings
missing_to_add.notes: Cosmetic/soft nudge only, not a hard deadline enforced anywhere in the mockup either.
